Elle couvre preconditions, creation utilisateur, login G3, validation JWT par G10, RBAC, endpoints utilisateurs G3, ingestion G8, analytics G8, ML G8 et cas d'erreur 400/401/403/404/409.

item.name: 00.2 - G10 OpenAPI contient G3 et G8

exec: pm.test('Contains G3 and G8 paths', function () { const p = pm.response.json().paths; pm.expect(p['/api/users']).to.exist; pm.expect(p['/api/v1/analytics/dashboard']).to.exist; pm.expect(p['/predict/peak-hours']).to.exist; });

item.name: 01 - G3 Auth et Utilisateurs via G10

exec: pm.test('User created and id captured', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.exist; pm.expect(j.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('testEmail')); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdUserId', String(j.id)); });

pm.test('G3 returns JWT and refresh token', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdUserToken', j.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdUserRefreshToken', j.refreshToken); });

item.name: 02 - Securite G10 pour G3 et G8

exec: pm.test('G3 rotates refresh token', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdUserToken', j.token); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdUserRefreshToken', j.refreshToken); });
